hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>plagiarism</voice> bedeutet Plagiat. <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>Citation</voice> bedeutet Zitat.

atoms.text: Plagiarism occurs when information or the exact wording of someone else's ideas are used without giving it as a source. It involves the unauthorised use of another person's intellectual property, such as texts, or images.
